title: Real-time analytics with ClickHouse

title: Use cases

title: User stories
description: Discover how users find success with ClickHouse as their ultra-fast solution for generating analytics.

title: Apache Iceberg
description: Apache Iceberg transforms data lakes into robust lakehouse architectures with its high-performance table format. This article explores Iceberg's origins, key features like ACID transactions and schema evolution, and demonstrates how to query Iceberg tables in ClickHouse using both direct and catalog-based approaches.

title: Application Performance Monitoring (APM)
description: In this guide, we'll explore Application Performance Monitoring (APM) - the practice of tracking and analyzing application behavior in real-time to ensure optimal performance and user experience.

title: Avro vs Parquet
description: In this guide, we'll learn all about the Apache Avro and Apache Parquet big data formats.

title: What is a data application?
description: In this guide, we'll learn all about data applications - what are they, what are the main components, and why would you want to create one?

title: Data catalog
description: In this guide, we'll explore data catalogs for open table formats like Iceberg, Delta Lake, and Hudi, explaining how these metadata systems make modern data lakes more powerful and accessible.

title: Data lakehouse
description: The data lakehouse combines the best of data warehouses and data lakes into a unified architecture. We'll explore its key components, advantages, and how ClickHouse fits into this modern analytics platform.

title: What is a JSON database?
description: In this guide, we'll learn about JSON, the types of databases that can store JSON, and how to work with JSON data in ClickHouse.

title: Understanding LLM Observability
description: In this guide, we'll explore how teams monitor and debug their LLM applications, helping them understand everything from response accuracy and token usage to the complex reasoning chains of AI agents.

title: Log monitoring
description: Discover the fundamentals of log monitoring systems, exploring different log types, monitoring techniques, and modern tools, with practical insights into how organizations leverage solutions like ClickHouse to manage massive log volumes efficiently and cost-effectively.

title: Network monitoring
description: In this guide, we'll explore how organizations implement network monitoring to gain visibility, troubleshoot issues, and ensure optimal performance across distributed infrastructures.

title: Observability
description: In this guide, we'll explore observability - the practice of understanding a system's internal state through its outputs, and how modern approaches are helping organizations gain deeper insights into their systems' behavior.

title: OLTP vs OLAP
description: Explore the differences between OLTP (Online Transaction Processing) and OLAP (Online Analytical Processing) systems, examining how they serve unique purposes, the challenges of implementing OLAP, and guidelines for selecting the right system for various use cases. Real-world examples will illustrate when and why each system excels, providing practical insights for application.

title: Open table formats
description: In this guide, we'll explore the Iceberg, Delta Lake, and Hudi open table formats.

title: An intro to OpenTelemetry (OTel)
description: In this guide, we’ll explore OpenTelemetry (OTel), a framework for collecting and standardizing telemetry data—metrics, logs, and traces—enhancing observability and performance monitoring in modern software systems.

title: Build a dashboard in Python with ClickHouse and Streamlit
description: In this guide, you'll learn how to build a Python dashboard using ClickHouse and Streamlit. We'll create a real-world example that visualizes Bluesky social media data, walking through everything from basic setup to interactive visualizations. Perfect for data scientists and analysts who want to share their insights through custom dashboards.

title: Real-time data visualization
description: This guide is all about real-time data visualization. We'll explore how it differs from normal visualization, see some examples, and learn about the tools we can use.

title: Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)
description: In this guide, we'll explore SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) - the central security system that collects, analyzes, and responds to security threats across your organization's entire infrastructure.

title: Structured logging
description: In this guide, we'll explore how structured logging transforms traditional text-based logs into queryable data, enabling organizations to build powerful monitoring, analysis, and automation capabilities at scale.

title: Structured, unstructured, and semi-structured data
description: In this guide, we explore the three main forms of data: structured data with rigid schemas like database tables, unstructured data like text and images with no predefined format, and semi-structured data like JSON that combines elements of both while maintaining flexibility.

title: Telemetry data explained
description: In this guide, we'll explore telemetry data - the vital information that helps us understand, monitor, and improve our software systems through the collection of metrics, logs, and traces.

title: Columnar databases explained
description: In this guide, we’ll explore columnar databases. How do they differ from row-based databases? What are they good at?  What are the advantages of using a column store?

title: What is real-time analytics?
description: In this guide, we'll learn all about real-time analytics - how does it compare to batch analytics, what are its main characteristics, use cases, and more.

title: An intro to time-series databases
description: In this guide, we’ll learn all about time-series data and its use cases, time-series databases, and how to query time-series data.
